# `<inttypes.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

printf format macros for the fixed-width integer types.

Only the PRI macros are provided, for a 32-bit ARM target where int32_t is long and int64_t is long long.

```c
#include <inttypes.h>
```
